en.title: Accessibility Digest: Playground Upgrades, Bank Renovation Model, and Student-Led Solutions
en.summary: On June 2, 2026, a Ph.D. student highlighted the importance of listening to disabled voices in developing accessibility solutions, while Taiwan's Taoyuan Bank Zhongping Branch received affirmation for its accessibility renovations, setting a model for historic building transformation. Additionally, the community in Boise celebrated a new playground with enhanced accessible features at Fairview Park.

highlights.title: Listening to the voices: Ph.D. student working on accessibility for those with disabilities - The Daily Times
Accessibility Renovation Results of Taoyuan Bank Zhongping Branch Affirmed, Setting a New Model for Historic Building Transformation
Community Gathers to Celebrate New Playground, More Accessible Features at Fairview Park - City of Boise

zh-TW.title: 無障礙每日摘要：遊樂場升級、銀行改造典範與學生導向解決方案
zh-TW.summary: 2026年6月2日，一位博士生強調傾聽殘障人士聲音以開發無障礙解決方案；台灣銀行中屏分行的無障礙改造成果獲肯定，成為歷史建築轉型的新典範。此外，博伊斯社區在費維爾公園慶祝新啟用的遊樂場，增添更多無障礙設施。

highlights.title: 傾聽聲音：博士生致力於殘障人士的無障礙工作 - The Daily Times
臺灣銀行中屏分行無障礙改造成果獲肯定 打造歷史建築轉型新典範
社區聚集慶祝費維爾公園新遊樂場，增添更多無障礙設施 - City of Boise
